features.title: Add gated-mutation boundary (apply-only)
features.description: Add live_apply_gated as the third boundary rung: approved create/update/apply actions are allowed only when each command carries an explicit operator-approved apply gate, while explicit teardown (terraform/tofu destroy, qm destroy, Proxmox/Satellite/Cloudflare/registry removal) stays blocked at every boundary. Plan_only and live_read_check remain unchanged; plaintext secrets stay prohibited.
verification: ./init.sh succeeds
Boundary tests prove gated apply is allowed only with an operator-approved apply gate under live_apply_gated
Boundary tests prove ungated apply, ungated Ansible converge, and explicit teardown are blocked under live_apply_gated
Boundary tests prove plaintext secrets remain blocked under live_apply_gated
LLM-free dry run writes output/infrastructure_handoff.md with allowed_boundary=live_apply_gated and no boundary findings
plan_only and live_read_check dry runs still pass with no regression
evidence: 2026-06-13 focused tests passed for tests.test_boundary (18 cases) with UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache UV_LINK_MODE=copy, covering gated apply allowed with marker, ungated apply blocked, terraform destroy blocked even with marker, gated/ungated Ansible converge, terraform plan allowed, and plaintext token blocked under live_apply_gated.
2026-06-13 LLM-free dry runs for plan_only, live_read_check, and live_apply_gated each wrote output/infrastructure_handoff.md with no Boundary Findings section (evaluate_boundary passed).
2026-06-13 ./init.sh passed: required files present, feature_list.json valid, Python compile passed, 35 unit tests passed, and git diff --check completed.
features.notes: Apply-only by design: there is no boundary value that permits an explicit teardown command. A future rung can add gated teardown if automated destroy becomes a real need. The approval gate is a per-command marker (operator-approved / approval gate / approved ... gate), mirroring the existing podman-login gate.
